title: Fecal Sample Collection from Mice
author: Amandine Even
materials: Quickly store tubes into -80 °C until analysis.

steps.title: Prepare individual empty cages
steps.instruction: Set up one clean, empty cage per mouse without food, water, or bedding, and label each cage with the animal’s tag to avoid confusion later.

steps.title: Label and pre‑chill collection tubes
steps.instruction: Label dry 1.6 mL Eppendorf tubes, weigh each on a precision balance, and place the tubes on dry ice.

steps.title: Prepare ethanol cleaning station
steps.instruction: Fill a beaker with ethanol and provide kimwipes for cleaning forceps between each collection to prevent cross‑contamination.

steps.title: Transfer mice to cages
steps.instruction: Place each mouse into its pre‑labeled cage.

steps.title: Collect fecal pellets
steps.instruction: Using forceps, collect all freshly produced fecal pellets, avoiding pellets that have contacted urine or are dried, and transfer them immediately into the pre‑chilled tube on dry ice; work quickly to prevent drying and clean the forceps between each collection.

substeps.instruction: Collect fresh pellets with forceps, avoiding urine‑contaminated or dried pellets
Transfer each pellet directly into the dry‑ice‑cooled tube
Clean and dry forceps with ethanol‑soaked kimwipes between collections, working quickly to prevent drying

steps.title: Weigh tubes with pellets
steps.instruction: Weigh each tube containing pellets on the precision balance, calculate the net pellet weight for subsequent normalization, and keep tubes on dry ice to minimize humidity.
